indexes.name: session_capabilities_session_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX session_capabilities_session_idx ON public.session_capabilities USING btree (session_id) WHERE (revoked_at IS NULL)

indexes.name: sessions_actor_id_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX sessions_actor_id_idx ON public.sessions USING btree (actor_id) WHERE (status = 'active'::text)

indexes.name: sessions_expires_at_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX sessions_expires_at_idx ON public.sessions USING btree (expires_at)

indexes.name: sessions_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sessions_pkey ON public.sessions USING btree (id)

indexes.name: sessions_token_hash_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sessions_token_hash_key ON public.sessions USING btree (token_hash)
